Test Case Description: Booking transfer successfully (same doctor different session)
Steps: Select one or more bookings. Open Transfer tab. Choose same doctor and a different session (same price). Enter remarks. Click Transfer Now.
Expected Result: Success toast. SMS sent. List and history updated. Form clears.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer successfully (different doctor same speciality)
Steps: Select bookings. In Transfer tab choose a different doctor (same speciality) and a session. Enter remarks. Transfer Now.
Expected Result: Success toast. Bookings appear in new doctor session. History shows from/in doctor names.

Steps: Select 2 or more bookings. Transfer to a session with enough slots. Enter remarks. Transfer Now.
Expected Result: All transferred. Correct appointment numbers. One success toast for N bookings.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer to leave session (disabled in UI)
Steps: Open Transfer tab. Choose a doctor. In session dropdown find a session marked (Leave).
Expected Result: Session is disabled and shows (Leave). Cannot select it.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer to session with different price (disabled in UI)
Steps: Choose a doctor whose session has different local/foreign fee. Open session dropdown.
Expected Result: Sessions with different price are disabled with (Not selectable due to price difference).

Test Case Description: Booking transfer to session whose previous session is not filled (disabled in UI)
Steps: Choose a doctor. In dropdown find a session that has a previous consecutive session not yet full.
Expected Result: Session is disabled with (Fill previous session first: date time).

Test Case Description: Booking transfer to session that has not filled previous session (backend)
Steps: Select a target session that has previous not full. Submit transfer (e.g. via API or race).
Expected Result: Error toast: Fill the previous session first (date time) before transferring.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer – target session full (limit exceeded)
Steps: Select more bookings than the target session has slots. Choose that session. Enter remarks. Transfer Now.
Expected Result: Error toast: Target session has room for X more. You selected Y. Reduce selection or choose another session.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer – refunded booking in selection
Steps: Ensure a refunded booking exists. Attempt to include it via API or verify UI has no checkbox for refunded row.
Expected Result: Backend returns refunded_booking error. In UI refunded rows have no checkbox.

Steps: Use bookings from a past day (if possible via data). Submit transfer.
Expected Result: Error: Previous day bookings cannot be transferred.

Steps: Select bookings that have doctor-payment receipt. Submit transfer.
Expected Result: Error: Found already paid bookings (doctor payment). Cannot transfer.

Test Case Description: Booking transfer – no bookings or empty remarks
Steps: Submit with no bookings selected. Then submit with empty remarks.
Expected Result: Error: No bookings selected. Then Error: Transfer remarks are required.

Test Case Description: Refunded booking – no checkbox and not in Select all
Steps: Open Bookings with refunded and non-refunded rows. Use Select all. Open Transfer tab.
Expected Result: Only non-refunded are selected. Refunded rows have no transfer checkbox.

Test Case Description: Transfer form reset when changing session in Bookings panel
Steps: Select bookings and fill Transfer doctor/session/remarks. Change the session in Bookings panel.
Expected Result: Transfer form (doctor session remarks) resets. Session list reloads when doctor chosen again.

Test Case Description: Transfer session auto-cleared when it becomes invalid
Steps: Select a valid transfer session. Change source session to one with different price or wait for eligibility that marks session as previous-not-full.
Expected Result: Transfer to session dropdown value clears automatically.

Steps: Select bookings. Fill doctor session remarks. Click Clear.
Expected Result: Doctor session and remarks clear. Booking selection in list is unchanged.

Test Case Description: Settle form shown for pending booking
Steps: Select a session. Select a pending booking (amber dot). Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: Settlement form shown: Payment Method (Cash/Card/Slip) and Settle Now (Rs. X) button.

Steps: Select a paid booking (green dot). Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: Message: Booking already paid. Settlement details card with Receipt No amount method date.

Steps: Select a canceled or refunded booking (red dot). Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: No settle form. Receipt details shown if any.

Test Case Description: Doctor on leave – settlement not allowed (UI)
Steps: Select a session on leave. Select a pending booking. Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: Message: Doctor is on leave for this session. Settlement is not allowed. No form.

Steps: Select a pending booking whose session date is yesterday (or any past date). Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: Message: Cannot settle a booking for a past session date. Only today's sessions can be settled. No form.

Test Case Description: Doctor departed – must arrive again before settle
Steps: Select a session where doctor has departed and has not arrived again. Select a pending booking. Open Settle tab.
Expected Result: Message: Doctor has departed. Doctor must arrive again before settlement is allowed. No form.

Steps: Pending booking. Settle tab. Payment Method Cash. Click Settle Now.
Expected Result: Settlement succeeds. Receipt created. Booking becomes paid. Toast: Settled.

Steps: Pending booking. Select Credit Card. Enter last 4 digits and Bank. Settle Now.
Expected Result: Receipt has card and bank. Booking becomes paid.

Steps: Pending booking. Select Slip. Enter Slip reference and Bank. Settle Now.
Expected Result: Receipt has slip ref and bank. Booking becomes paid.

Test Case Description: After settle – list and tab update
Steps: Complete settle for a pending booking. Check list and reopen Settle tab.
Expected Result: Booking shows Paid (green) in list. Settle tab shows Booking already paid and new receipt details.

Steps: Open Settle tab without selecting a booking.
Expected Result: Message: Select a booking.

Steps: Submit settle for a booking that is already paid.
Expected Result: Error: Booking is not pending payment.

Steps: Start shift on Channel Booking. Open Request Float. Select bulk cashier. Enter denominations (e.g. 5000 x 2). Submit.
Expected Result: Request created. Pending status. Top bar shows Float request is pending.

Steps: Open Request Float. Leave denominations at zero or empty. Submit.
Expected Result: Validation error: total amount must be greater than zero. Request not created.

Steps: With one pending float request already open Request Float and submit another.
Expected Result: Error: You already have a pending float request. Wait for approval or rejection.

Steps: As bulk cashier go to Bulk Cashier. Open pending request. Click Match request. Select source cash account. Approve.
Expected Result: Approved. Print slip with 4-digit code and QR. Cashier sees Receive float popup.

Test Case Description: Approve float – approve less with reason
Steps: As bulk cashier approve with total less than requested. Enter reason for less. Approve.
Expected Result: Approved with reason. Print slip. Cashier can receive the approved (lower) amount.

Steps: Try to approve a request that is already approved or rejected or cancelled.
Expected Result: Error: Request is no longer pending.

Steps: As a user who is not the assigned bulk cashier try to approve the request.
Expected Result: Error: Only the assigned bulk cashier can approve.

Test Case Description: Approve float – cannot give more than requested
Steps: As bulk cashier try to approve with denominations totalling more than requested.
Expected Result: Error: Cannot give more than requested. Approved total must not exceed requested amount.

Steps: Select a source cash account whose balance is less than the approved amount. Approve.
Expected Result: Error: Insufficient balance in source account. Available X LKR required Y LKR.

Test Case Description: Approve float – approve less without reason
Steps: Approve with total less than requested but leave reason for less empty.
Expected Result: Error: Reason for giving less is required when approved amount is below requested.

Steps: Cashier with approved request opens Receive float. Enters correct 4-digit code from slip. Confirms.
Expected Result: Receipt confirmed. Status RECEIVED. Cashier float balance updates. Journal entry created.

Steps: Cashier enters incorrect 4-digit code in Receive float popup.
Expected Result: Error: Invalid receive code.

Test Case Description: Receive float – only requester can receive
Steps: As another user (e.g. different cashier) try to receive an approved request (e.g. via API).
Expected Result: Error: Only the requesting cashier can confirm receipt.

Steps: Try to receive a request that is PENDING or already RECEIVED or REJECTED or CANCELLED.
Expected Result: Error: Only approved requests can be received.

Steps: As assigned bulk cashier open pending request. Enter reject reason. Reject.
Expected Result: Request status REJECTED. Requester sees update. No journal entry.

Steps: Try to reject a request that is already approved or received or cancelled.
Expected Result: Error: Request is no longer pending.

Test Case Description: Reject float – only assigned bulk cashier
Steps: As user who is not the assigned bulk cashier try to reject.
Expected Result: Error: Only the assigned bulk cashier can reject.

Steps: As requester with pending request open dropdown. Cancel with reason.
Expected Result: Request status CANCELLED. No journal entry.

Test Case Description: Cancel float – only requester can cancel
Steps: As bulk cashier or other user try to cancel a pending request.
Expected Result: Error or Cancel button not shown. Only requester can cancel their own float request.

Steps: Cashier with approved request opens Receive float. Click Reject (cancel float). Enter reason. Confirm.
Expected Result: Request status CANCELLED. No journal entry. Bulk cashier sees update.

Steps: Try to decline (reject receive) a request that is PENDING or already RECEIVED.
Expected Result: Error: Only an approved (not yet received) request can be declined.

Test Case Description: Decline approved float – only requester can decline
Steps: As another user try to decline an approved request.
Expected Result: Error: Only the requesting cashier can decline to receive this float.

Test Case Description: Float balance and request status in top bar
Steps: With active shift and float permission check top bar.
Expected Result: Shows Float balance (LKR X.XX) and if pending Float request is pending with dropdown. Manual refresh icon updates balance.

Test Case Description: Bulk Cashier – active shifts and float balances
Steps: As user with Bulk Cashier Dashboard go to Bulk Cashier page.
Expected Result: Section shows active shifts and real-time float balance per cashier.

Steps: Start shift. Open End shift Handover. Select a recipient (different user). Enter amounts per method. Optionally enter discrepancy reason. Submit.
Expected Result: Handover submitted. Shift status becomes Handover pending. Sender sees summary in shift bar. Recipient sees it in Handed over to me list.

Test Case Description: Submit handover – cannot hand over to self
Steps: Open handover dialog. Select yourself as recipient or same user. Submit.
Expected Result: Validation error: Handover cannot be to yourself. Select another recipient. Handover not created.

Test Case Description: Submit handover – shift must be active

Expected Result: When paused only Resume shown; no End shift. When handover pending error if trying to start another. Handover only allowed when shift is Active.

Test Case Description: Submit handover – pending float request blocks
Steps: With active shift create a float request and leave it pending. Open End shift Handover and try to proceed.
Expected Result: Alert: You have a pending float request. Proceed to handover button disabled. Cancel or wait for float approval before handover.

Steps: Open handover. Leave recipient unselected or leave required method amounts invalid. Submit.
Expected Result: Validation messages shown. Handover not submitted. Server returns clear validation error.

Test Case Description: Handed over to me – list and access

Expected Result: List loads with pending handovers. From shows name and staff code. View action opens detail page.

Test Case Description: Handover detail – view who and how much

Expected Result: Shows Handover from name and staff code. Shift and handover dates. Total handed over and method breakdown. Issues section if till vs entered differs.

Test Case Description: Handover detail – entries to verify and tick

Expected Result: Ticked rows show green background and green left bar. Subtotals in amount column per method. Progress shows X of Y checked.

Test Case Description: Approve and Receive – disabled until all ticked
Steps: On handover detail do not tick all entries. Check Approve and Receive button.
Expected Result: Button disabled. Tooltip says to tick all entries first. When all ticked or no entries button enables.

Steps: Tick all entries. Click Approve and Receive. In dialog enter optional comments. Confirm.
Expected Result: Success. Handover approved. Funds to bulk cashier till. Journal created with full description. Shift ended. Redirect to handovers list.

Test Case Description: Approve and Receive – journal and till

Steps: As sender with handover pending open shift bar dropdown. Cancel handover.
Expected Result: Pending handover cancelled. Shift returns to Active. Recipient no longer sees it in Handed over to me.

Test Case Description: Only recipient can approve or reject

Expected Result: Error or action not available. Only designated recipient can approve and receive or reject.

Test Case Description: Handover permission – Handed over to me

Steps: On handover detail page scroll down. Check header with Back Reject Approve and Receive.

Steps: With no shift or paused or handover-pending try settle booking request float approve float receive float or ledger receipt.
Expected Result: Error or block: You must have an active shift. Only ACTIVE shift allows till-related operations.

Test Case Description: Cashier summary link on handover detail
Steps: On handover detail scroll to Need full receipt-level detail. Click Open cashier summary report.
Expected Result: Opens cashier summary report in new tab for sender and shift period. Report shows receipt-level data.

Steps: On handover detail view Till balance vs entered table.
Expected Result: Table shows per method Till expected Entered Difference. Shorts in red Over in amber. Resolve differences before approving.

Steps: Open channel booking in two tabs as same cashier. In one tab submit handover. In other tab check shift bar.
